global_prompt: A cinematic anime-style comedy scene set inside a quiet, spacious library with towering bookshelves, wooden reading tables, and warm afternoon sunlight filtering through tall windows. local_prompts: The camera zooms out from a large NO FOOD ALLOWED sign on the wall of a quiet library.
